title: Prepare two-client version and configuration evidence checklist
selection_reason: Repository first-class harness entry files CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md; both publish stdio MCP client config. kizuki-mcp is stdio-only. Cursor docs retrieved as HTML shell only and were not used as a template.

checks.name: existing two-client synthetic test present
checks.detail: InMemoryTransport; not live clients; not duplicated

checks.name: gemini --version
checks.missing: gemini binary; install forbidden; public MCP page did not document a version flag

checks.name: live two-client continuation
checks.missing: real Claude Code and Gemini CLI sessions, initialized vault, Linux x64 file custody

verification.reason: Read-only preparation archive without node_modules, without client binaries, and without authority to install or mutate owner config. Static source/docs mapping only.

findings.detail: Existing two-client proof uses SDK InMemoryTransport. It is not Claude Code or Gemini CLI continuation. P046 must not treat that test as Stage A live-client evidence.
Ready line always reports tools=9 (TOOLS.length). Observe grant.tools via enrollment JSON and system_health.principal.tools, not stderr.
Client-side tool filters are not a substitute for the eight-field Core grant.
kizuki-mcp has no HTTP/SSE transport. Client templates must stay stdio. Claude Code url-without-type entries are skipped.
file: credential delivery requires qualified Linux x64 glibc. Other platforms return unsupported_platform.
Fetched Gemini MCP/README pages did not document gemini --version. Capture whatever the installed binary prints; do not invent a version string.

execution_gaps: No /repo/node_modules; bun test and kizuki-mcp process probes unexecuted.
claude and gemini binaries absent; not installed.
No live vault, no owner config mutation, no continuation claim.

use: Two redacted stdio templates (Claude Code .mcp.json, Gemini CLI settings.json)
do_not: Claim this packet ran live clients
Replace P006 docs, P003 evidence design, or P015 schema work
Treat green synthetic tests as unfamiliar-user or live-client qualification

next_step: P046 executes the checklist on a Linux x64 host with Bun 1.3.14, an initialized vault, and separately installed Claude Code plus Gemini CLI, recording real client versions and enrollment JSON without copying tokens or host paths.
limitations_preserved: No native/account/model/human qualification or release acceptance claim.
Artifacts feed the P DAG and must be reviewed/rebased before production use.
